models.sourcePreviewMethod: Independent bone/bindpose/weight positions rendered through the same VAT GPU shader; topology/UV/normals shared. NOT a separate native SkinnedMeshRenderer/material acceptance.
warnings: Body height is measured on skinned bind geometry, excluding declared rigid attachments. Forward must already be +Z. Grounding is bind-pose only.
Visual size does not automatically tune collision, formation, attack reach, camera or large-creature behaviour. Agent radius is copied explicitly into a private config.
Human checklist: neck/shoulders, hand-to-weapon contact, feet/ground, all actions, palette/LOD continuity. Automated checks are not human acceptance.
PaletteGrid is an explicit authoring contract, not a universal texture simplifier. Inspect colour boundaries manually.
